Angie Bell died on 11 September, 1937 and was buried at John Wesley Cemetary in Kent Co., DE. Her husband, Andrew Mosley, called one of the last of the Kent Co. splint basketmakers, died in 1944. One of his baskets was collected by C. A. Weslager and turned over to the Heye Foundation Museum in New York.
